title: 18695 - 18695/P2263/008803
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Hoses incorrect connected, disconnected, blocked or leaking
Solenoid Valve for Boost Pressure Control (N75) defective
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Solenoid Valve for Boost Pressure Control (N75)
Kontrol edin:  Cam Adjusters as per Repair Manual
technicalNotes:
On some engines, TPI 2016970 may apply.  Boost Pressure Control (N75) part number 06F-906-283-D can cause P2263 and/or P0234.
This fault code will set on vehicles equipped with a Charge Air Pressure Actuator Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G581) when the sensor output voltage exceeds 4.5 volts.
